scope: 749 frozen entries / 590 providers; all retained contract/path decisions reconciled against actual cross-course API results. New full executable review is limited to the 12 nominated links.
candidatePolicy: Every other-bank entry with the same topic, any shared track, an explicit bridge or shared canonical provider is considered. Enumerate actual API results, without the suggestions limit or provider deduplication.

boundaryRules.sharedProvider: A later lesson using the same provider is repeated practice, not a higher demand.
boundaryRules.sameScope: A reviewed equal stage gives similarity; range, format or course labels do not establish a direction.
boundaryRules.related: Retain the recorded methods, representations, domains and branch boundaries. Related paths deliberately do not rank these mixed or qualitatively different demands.
boundaryRules.topicOnly: Retain the earlier provider-specific no-ranked-counterpart decision. A topic name alone supplies no prerequisite or difficulty evidence.
boundaryRules.localOnly: Within-course directions remain useful but do not count as cross-course coverage. Do not invent a cross-course anchor to improve the count.
boundaryRules.conflicting: Retain the API conservative related result when reviewed paths disagree. Do not discard inconvenient evidence to force a direction.

limits: Reviewed residual means no direction validated in this evidence and nominated-link pass. It does not prove that no defensible future link exists, and does not establish measured student difficulty.
